corrections.source_grounded_mechanism: A two-symbol short-horizon imbalance detector enters beyond a configured threshold and exits as the imbalance contracts, subject to beta-smoothing, minimum-correlation and trading-time inputs.
corrections.execution_topology_warning: Either leg may be disabled with a zero lot size. That mode is directional exposure informed by cross-symbol divergence, not market-neutral pair execution.
corrections.canonical_route: Keep rolling-OLS, EWLS and Kalman residual variants only as independently preregistered quant-generated ablations. Never label them reconstructions of the proprietary EA.
corrections.dedupe_result: No source-attributed Precise Pair Trading Pro card exists in the repository. The existing generic residual-pair machinery remains valid and unchanged.
